ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels restricted to <5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast localized clusters of white and pinkish pixels are mapped to the extreme distal tips (0, 0.95 and 1.0, 0.95 relative coordinates).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle and low pixel depth relative to the total lobe chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Linear boundary shows low-amplitude, low-frequency variations along the inner trailing edges, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity following a parabolic curve from the notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast pixel clusters located at the extreme tips of both lobes, exhibiting roughly circular and clustered geometries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular morphology and perceived loss of edge integrity at the distal tips of both lobes, corresponding with high-intensity pixel clusters.
